prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 9 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1134; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a side-impact motor vehicle collision at an intersection and reported acute low back pain with muscle spasm and reduced lumbar range of motion. Initial examination documented paraspinal tenderness, limited forward flexion, and a negative straight leg raise bilaterally. Neurological screening was intact in both lower extremities, with no focal deficits in strength, sensation, or reflexes. Imaging was not indicated at the initial visit given the absence of red flag findings.

Over the course of nine visits, treatment consisted of a structured program of manual therapy, progressive lumbar stabilization exercises, and home exercise instruction, along with short-term use of muscle relaxants and anti-inflammatory medication as needed. Pain scores improved steadily from moderate to mild levels, and range of motion approached functional limits by the later visits. Sleep and daily activity tolerance improved in parallel.

At the most recent visit, the patient reported significant but incomplete resolution of symptoms, with occasional stiffness after prolonged sitting. Prognosis for full recovery is good. Continued independent exercise, ergonomic modifications, and follow-up as needed are recommended.
